correctness.rationale: The heights recursion gives minimal forbidden exponent \(T_k\) by induction. The p-adic joint forbidden measure follows from the exhaustive three-case split \(a<r\), \(a=r\), \(a>r\), including the exceptional \(p=2\) middle branch. CRT with summable \(p^{-T_k}\) tails proves true natural density limits. The overlap gamma is zero exactly for \(v_p(t)<T_k\), giving exact minimizers and density; strict local upper bounds and summable product convergence yield unattained supremum and covariance signs. Exact rational modular checks were replayed from verify.py, with no finite-to-infinite inference.

originality.rationale: The accepted claim concerns the complete correlation response for arbitrary fixed nonzero shifts at every level \(k\ge2\), together with an exact extremal-shift classification and covariance sign reversal. Its displacement-one specialization is acknowledged as a corollary of an existing general M-free theorem, and the height-one squarefree specialization is classical. The inspected primary papers do not imply the claimed full displacement spectrum or extremal laws; residual unindexed general-M-free shift literature remains a risk.
residual_risks: A general arbitrary-shift formula for M-free integers may exist in unindexed or untranslated number-theory literature; the searches and cited theorems do not establish universal uniqueness.

Mirsky (1949) full primary text and Rieger (1973) on M-free classes were not separately inspected in full; the 2026 general M-free theorem provides relevant precise comparison but cannot exclude all unpublished implications.
The special cases k=1 and shift 1 are known; originality is restricted explicitly to the complete k>=2 shift spectrum, extremizers and covariance structure.

value.rationale: Shift-correlation statistics of a recursively defined multiplicative height level cannot be reconstructed from its known one-point density or adjacent pair value. The result gives a full infinite-shift local law, complete classification and density of minimizing displacements, strict nonattainment of the upper envelope, and a provable covariance sign reversal. These are natural structural arithmetic invariants, not arbitrary fixed-parameter computations; the known specializations are excluded from the novelty claim.
